## Setup - load packages and folder structure
```{r, message=FALSE}
rm(list = ls())

# set up folder paths
library(here)
project.folder = paste0(here::here(), '/')
source(paste0(project.folder, 'create_folder_structure.R'))
source(paste0(functions.folder, 'script_initiate.R'))

# load required packages
library(ggplot2)
library(rgdal)
library(sf)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(readr)
library(purrr)
library(stringr)
library(broom)
```

## Load all processed data (from b_00_native_land_explore.Rmd)
```{r}
# Shapefile data with state assignments
shapefile.data <- readRDS(paste0(project.folder, "data/processed/shapefile_data_all.rds"))
shapefile.data$GEOID <- as.character(shapefile.data$GEOID)

# State population summary
state_pop <- readRDS(paste0(project.folder, "data/processed/state_population_summary.rds"))

# State lookup from processed data
state_lookup <- shapefile.data %>%
  filter(!is.na(STATE_NAME)) %>%
  distinct(GEOID, STATE_NAME)

# WBGT Regression
dat.wbgt.summarised.regression <- readRDS(
  paste0(wbgt.folder, 'weighted_area_raster_native_wbgtmax_daily_',
         start_year_wbgt, '_', end_year_wbgt, '_regression_analysis.rds')
) %>%
  mutate(native_id = str_pad(as.character(native_id), width = 7, side = "left", pad = "0"))

# WBGT over time
dat.wbgt.summarised <- readRDS(
  paste0(wbgt.folder, 'weighted_area_raster_native_wbgtmax_daily_',
         start_year_wbgt, '_', end_year_wbgt, '_over_time.rds')
) %>%
  mutate(
    native_id = str_pad(as.character(native_id), width = 7, side = "left", pad = "0"),
    year = as.numeric(as.character(year))
  )

# State-level WBGT over time (needed for disparity calculations)
dat.wbgt.summarised.merged.weighted.state <- readRDS(
  paste0(wbgt.folder, 'weighted_area_raster_state_wbgtmax_daily_',
         start_year_wbgt, '_', end_year_wbgt, '_over_time.rds')
) %>%
  rename(
    wbgt_26_state = wbgt_26,
    wbgt_28_state = wbgt_28,
    wbgt_30_state = wbgt_30,
    wbgt_35_state = wbgt_35
  )

message("All data loaded successfully")
```

## Native Explore Stats
```{r}
territories_with_pop <- sum(!is.na(shapefile.data$POP_2020) & shapefile.data$POP_2020 > 0)
territories_no_pop  <- sum(is.na(shapefile.data$POP_2020) | shapefile.data$POP_2020 == 0)

message("SUMMARY STATISTICS")
message("Total territories: ", nrow(shapefile.data))
message("Unique names: ", n_distinct(shapefile.data$NAME))
message("States with territories: ", n_distinct(state_lookup$STATE_NAME, na.rm = TRUE))
message("Total 2020 population: ", format(sum(shapefile.data$POP_2020, na.rm = TRUE), big.mark = ","))
message("Territories with pop > 0: ", territories_with_pop)
message("Territories with NA/zero pop: ", territories_no_pop)

# Population by State
print(state_pop, n = Inf)
```

## Values (Pertaining to figure 1)
```{r}
message("Potentially hazardous heat per standard environmental epidemiological research is defined as WBGT > 28\u00B0C threshold")

# Territories with increasing dangerous heat days
territories_with_trends <- dat.wbgt.summarised.regression %>%
  left_join(shapefile.data, by = c('native_id' = 'GEOID')) %>%
  filter(!is.na(POP_2020), POP_2020 > 0)

territories_increasing_28 <- territories_with_trends %>%
  filter(total_change_wbgt_28 > 0)

n_increasing <- nrow(territories_increasing_28)
n_total <- nrow(territories_with_trends)
pct_increasing <- 100 * n_increasing / n_total

message(sprintf("Territories with increasing heat days (WBGT > 28\u00B0C): %d out of %d (%.1f%%)",
            n_increasing, n_total, pct_increasing))

# Geographic distribution
increasing_by_state <- territories_increasing_28 %>%
  group_by(STATE_NAME) %>%
  summarise(
    n_territories = n(),
    total_pop = sum(POP_2020, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_increase = mean(total_change_wbgt_28, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(n_territories))

print(head(increasing_by_state, 10))

# Person-day exposure
dat.wbgt.with.pop <- dat.wbgt.summarised %>%
  left_join(shapefile.data, by = c('native_id' = 'GEOID')) %>%
  filter(!is.na(POP_2020), POP_2020 > 0)

local_years <- sort(unique(dat.wbgt.with.pop$year))
last_5_years <- local_years[(length(local_years) - 4):length(local_years)]

exposure_by_state <- dat.wbgt.with.pop %>%
  filter(year %in% last_5_years) %>%
  group_by(STATE_NAME, FUNCSTAT) %>%
  summarise(
    population = sum(POP_2020, na.rm = TRUE),
    wbgt_28_days = weighted.mean(wbgt_28, POP_2020, na.rm = TRUE),
    person_days = wbgt_28_days * population,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  group_by(STATE_NAME) %>%
  summarise(
    total_pop = sum(population),
    total_person_days = sum(person_days),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    pct_pop = 100 * total_pop / sum(total_pop),
    pct_exposure = 100 * total_person_days / sum(total_person_days)
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(total_person_days))

top_2_states <- head(exposure_by_state, 2)
top_2_combined_exposure <- sum(top_2_states$pct_exposure)
top_2_combined_pop <- sum(top_2_states$pct_pop)

message("   Top 2 states: ", paste(top_2_states$STATE_NAME, collapse = " and "))
message("   Combined exposure: ", sprintf("%.1f%%", top_2_combined_exposure))
message("   Combined population: ", sprintf("%.1f%%", top_2_combined_pop))
```

## Values (Pertaining to figure 2)
```{r}
states_data <- readOGR(
  dsn = paste0(data.folder, "shapefiles/states"),
  layer = "states",
  verbose = FALSE
)@data

state_fips_lookup <- shapefile.data %>%
  filter(!is.na(STATE_NAME)) %>%
  distinct(STATE_NAME) %>%
  left_join(
    states_data %>% select(STATE_NAME, STATE_FIPS),
    by = "STATE_NAME"
  )

# Build Native vs State comparison (self-contained - no dependency on Figure 2)
dat.wbgt.summarised.merged.weighted.native.state <- dat.wbgt.summarised %>%
  left_join(
    shapefile.data %>% select(GEOID, STATE_NAME, POP_2020),
    by = c("native_id" = "GEOID")
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(STATE_NAME), !is.na(POP_2020), POP_2020 > 0) %>%
  group_by(STATE_NAME, year) %>%
  summarise(
    wbgt_28 = weighted.mean(wbgt_28, POP_2020, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  left_join(state_fips_lookup, by = "STATE_NAME") %>%
  rename(state = STATE_FIPS) %>%
  left_join(dat.wbgt.summarised.merged.weighted.state, by = c("state", "year")) %>%
  mutate(wbgt_28_diff = wbgt_28 - wbgt_28_state)

# Panel a - Native vs State comparison
message("Panel a - Native vs State Disparity:")
message("  States: ", n_distinct(dat.wbgt.summarised.merged.weighted.native.state$STATE_NAME))
message("  Years: ", length(unique(dat.wbgt.summarised.merged.weighted.native.state$year)))

# Top 5 states with largest disparities
top5_disparities <- dat.wbgt.summarised.merged.weighted.native.state %>%
  group_by(STATE_NAME) %>%
  summarise(mean_diff = mean(wbgt_28_diff, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = 'drop') %>%
  arrange(desc(mean_diff)) %>%
  slice_head(n = 5)

message("  Top 5 states with largest disparities:")
for(i in 1:nrow(top5_disparities)) {
  message("    ", i, ". ", top5_disparities$STATE_NAME[i], ": ",
          round(top5_disparities$mean_diff[i], 2), " days/year")
}

if (!"total_change_disparity_wbgt_28" %in% names(dat.wbgt.summarised.regression)) {
  message("\nComputing disparity regression (normally done in Figure 2)...")

  # Individual Native vs state comparison
  dat.individual.native.state <- dat.wbgt.summarised %>%
    left_join(
      shapefile.data %>% select(GEOID, STATE_NAME, POP_2020),
      by = c("native_id" = "GEOID")
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(STATE_NAME), !is.na(POP_2020), POP_2020 > 0) %>%
    left_join(state_fips_lookup, by = "STATE_NAME") %>%
    rename(state = STATE_FIPS) %>%
    left_join(dat.wbgt.summarised.merged.weighted.state, by = c("state", "year")) %>%
    mutate(wbgt_28_diff = wbgt_28 - wbgt_28_state)

  local_years_reg <- sort(unique(dat.individual.native.state$year))

  dat.disparity.regression.28 <- dat.individual.native.state %>%
    group_by(native_id) %>%
    do(tidy(lm(wbgt_28_diff ~ year, data = .))) %>%
    filter(term == 'year') %>%
    select(native_id, estimate) %>%
    mutate(
      total_change_disparity_wbgt_28 = estimate * length(local_years_reg),
      annual_change_disparity_wbgt_28 = estimate
    ) %>%
    select(native_id, annual_change_disparity_wbgt_28, total_change_disparity_wbgt_28)

  dat.wbgt.summarised.regression <- dat.wbgt.summarised.regression %>%
    left_join(dat.disparity.regression.28, by = "native_id")
}

## Figure 2b output
dat.wbgt.summarised.regression.output <- dat.wbgt.summarised.regression %>%
  select(native_id, total_change_wbgt_28) %>%
  mutate(total_change_wbgt_28 = round(total_change_wbgt_28, 1)) %>%
  left_join(shapefile.data %>% select(GEOID, NAME, STATE_NAME, POP_2020),
            by = c('native_id' = 'GEOID')) %>%
  filter(!is.na(POP_2020), POP_2020 > 0) %>%
  rename(territory_name = NAME)

## Figure 2c output
dat.wbgt.summarised.regression.disparity.output <- dat.wbgt.summarised.regression %>%
  select(native_id, total_change_disparity_wbgt_28) %>%
  mutate(total_change_disparity_wbgt_28 = round(total_change_disparity_wbgt_28, 1)) %>%
  left_join(shapefile.data %>% select(GEOID, NAME, STATE_NAME, POP_2020),
            by = c('native_id' = 'GEOID')) %>%
  filter(!is.na(POP_2020), POP_2020 > 0) %>%
  rename(territory_name = NAME)

# Panel b - Total change over time
message("\nPanel b - Total Change in Heat Exposure:")
message("  Territories: ", nrow(dat.wbgt.summarised.regression.output))

mean_total_change <- mean(dat.wbgt.summarised.regression.output$total_change_wbgt_28, na.rm = TRUE)
message("  Mean total change: ", round(mean_total_change, 1), " days")

top5_total <- dat.wbgt.summarised.regression.output %>%
  arrange(desc(total_change_wbgt_28)) %>%
  slice_head(n = 5)

message("  Top 5 territories with largest total change:")
for(i in 1:nrow(top5_total)) {
  message("    ", i, ". ", top5_total$territory_name[i], ": ",
          round(top5_total$total_change_wbgt_28[i], 1), " days")
}

# Panel c - Disparity change over time
message("\nPanel c - Change in Native-State Disparity:")
message("  Territories: ", nrow(dat.wbgt.summarised.regression.disparity.output))

mean_disparity_change <- mean(dat.wbgt.summarised.regression.disparity.output$total_change_disparity_wbgt_28, na.rm = TRUE)
message("  Mean disparity change: ", round(mean_disparity_change, 1), " days")

top5_disparity <- dat.wbgt.summarised.regression.disparity.output %>%
  arrange(desc(total_change_disparity_wbgt_28)) %>%
  slice_head(n = 5)

message("  Top 5 territories with largest disparity change:")
for(i in 1:nrow(top5_disparity)) {
  message("    ", i, ". ", top5_disparity$territory_name[i], ": ",
          round(top5_disparity$total_change_disparity_wbgt_28[i], 1), " days")
}
```

## Save
```{r}
dir.create(paste0(project.folder, "figures/Statistics"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

capture.output(
  {
    cat("# Stats\n\n")

    ## Native Explore Stats
    cat("## Native Explore Stats\n\n")
    cat(sprintf("- Total territories: %d\n", nrow(shapefile.data)))
    cat(sprintf("- Unique names: %d\n", n_distinct(shapefile.data$NAME)))
    cat(sprintf("- States with territories: %d\n", n_distinct(state_lookup$STATE_NAME, na.rm = TRUE)))
    cat(sprintf("- Total 2020 population: %s\n", format(sum(shapefile.data$POP_2020, na.rm = TRUE), big.mark = ",")))
    cat(sprintf("- Territories with pop > 0: %d\n", sum(shapefile.data$POP_2020 > 0, na.rm = TRUE)))
    cat(sprintf("- Territories with NA/zero pop: %d\n\n", sum(is.na(shapefile.data$POP_2020) | shapefile.data$POP_2020 == 0)))
    print(state_pop, n = Inf)

    ## Figure 1
    cat("\n## Figure 1\n\n")
    cat(sprintf("- Territories with increasing heat days (WBGT > 28C): %d out of %d (%.1f%%)\n\n",
                n_increasing, n_total, pct_increasing))
    print(head(increasing_by_state, 10), n = Inf)
    cat("\n")
    cat(sprintf("- Top 2 states: %s and %s\n", top_2_states$STATE_NAME[1], top_2_states$STATE_NAME[2]))
    cat(sprintf("- Combined exposure: %.1f%%\n", top_2_combined_exposure))
    cat(sprintf("- Combined population: %.1f%%\n", top_2_combined_pop))

    ## Figure 2
    cat("\n## Figure 2\n\n")
    cat("### Panel a\n")
    cat(sprintf("- States: %d\n", n_distinct(dat.wbgt.summarised.merged.weighted.native.state$STATE_NAME)))
    cat(sprintf("- Years: %d\n\n", length(unique(dat.wbgt.summarised.merged.weighted.native.state$year))))
    print(top5_disparities, n = Inf)

    cat("\n### Panel b\n")
    cat(sprintf("- Territories: %d\n", nrow(dat.wbgt.summarised.regression.output)))
    cat(sprintf("- Mean total change: %.1f days\n\n", mean_total_change))
    print(top5_total, n = Inf)

    cat("\n### Panel c\n")
    cat(sprintf("- Territories: %d\n", nrow(dat.wbgt.summarised.regression.disparity.output)))
    cat(sprintf("- Mean disparity change: %.1f days\n\n", mean_disparity_change))
    print(top5_disparity, n = Inf)
  },
  file = paste0(project.folder, "figures/Statistics/stats.md")
)

message("\nStats saved to figures/Statistics/stats.md")
```
